name: Westfield UTC
description: Westfield UTC is a premier luxury shopping destination in San Diego's University City neighborhood, featuring world-class retailers including Louis Vuitton, CHANEL, Apple, and Nordstrom alongside exceptional dining experiences like Din Tai Fung and Javier's. This modern open-air center combines high-end fashion, entertainment including AMC Theatres, and a carefully curated mix of lifestyle brands in an upscale Southern California setting.
demographics: Affluent coastal community with high household incomes, University City area near UC San Diego, attracts upscale shoppers from La Jolla and surrounding San Diego neighborhoods
summary: An upscale open-air regional mall in San Diego featuring luxury retailers, premier dining, and entertainment in the heart of La Jolla Village.
